categories.title: General Inquiry
categories.description: Everything you need to know about the WheelsForDeals ecosystem.

faqs.question: What is WheelsForDeals?
faqs.answer: WheelsForDeals is a curated marketplace for pre-owned bikes. Every bike listed undergoes a thorough inspection and editorial review to meet our standards of quality, provenance, and performance.

faqs.question: How do I verify the authenticity of a listed bike?
faqs.answer: Each listing includes a digital Provenance Passport tracking ownership history, service logs, and official inspection certificates. View this on the product detail page under the Authenticity tab.

faqs.question: What membership tiers are available?
faqs.answer: We offer three tiers: Explorer (Standard), Premiere (Priority Access), and Elite (Invitation Only). Premiere members get 24-hour early access to new curations, while Elite members receive dedicated concierge service.

faqs.question: Can I cancel a transaction after it has been initiated?
faqs.answer: Transactions can be cancelled within a 12-hour Reflection Window without penalty. After this period, a curation fee may apply to cover logistics and administrative efforts already undertaken.

categories.title: Buying a Bike
categories.description: All you need to know about purchasing through WheelsForDeals.

faqs.question: What should I check before buying a used bike?
faqs.answer: Always check the service history, RC book, insurance, chassis number, and overall mechanical condition. Our inspection report covers all of these and more.

faqs.question: Is a test ride available before purchasing?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can schedule a test ride at our nearest hub or request a home test ride based on availability in your area.

faqs.question: Can I get financing to buy a used bike?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer easy financing options with competitive interest rates and flexible EMI plans for eligible customers. Apply directly from the product listing page.

faqs.question: What documents do I need to complete a purchase?
faqs.answer: You will need a valid ID proof, address proof, and a passport-size photograph. Our team will guide you through any additional paperwork.

categories.title: Selling Your Bike
categories.description: Get the best price for your bike with our transparent selling process.

faqs.question: How do I sell my bike through WheelsForDeals?
faqs.answer: Submit your bike details through our Sell page. Our team will contact you within 24 hours to schedule a free doorstep or hub inspection and provide a price estimate.

faqs.question: How is the value of my bike calculated?
faqs.answer: Pricing is based on your bike brand, model, year, mileage, mechanical condition, and current market demand. We strive for transparent, fair valuations.

faqs.question: How long does payment take after selling?
faqs.answer: Once the deal is confirmed and paperwork is complete, payment is processed on the same day directly to your bank account.

faqs.question: Can I sell a bike that is still under finance?
faqs.answer: Yes, but you must clear any pending dues beforehand or provide an NOC from your financier. Our team can help guide you through this.

categories.title: Curation Standards
categories.description: How we ensure every bike meets our quality benchmark before listing.

faqs.question: What is the curation process?
faqs.answer: Every bike undergoes a comprehensive 48-point inspection covering engine health, frame integrity, tyre condition, electrical systems, and documentation validity before being approved for listing.

faqs.question: Are all inspections done in-house?
faqs.answer: Yes, our certified technicians conduct all inspections at our own hubs. We do not rely on third-party inspection services to maintain quality consistency.

faqs.question: What happens if a bike fails the inspection?
faqs.answer: Bikes that do not meet our curation standards are rejected. Sellers are informed and provided with a detailed report on the areas that did not pass.

faqs.question: Do curated bikes come with a warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes, selected curated models come with a limited warranty. Coverage details are mentioned on the individual product listing page and can vary by model and condition grade.

categories.title: Shipping & Delivery
categories.description: Everything about how we deliver your bike safely to your doorstep.

faqs.question: Do you offer home delivery for bikes?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer doorstep delivery across major cities. Delivery timelines and charges vary by location and are displayed at checkout.

faqs.question: How is the bike prepared for delivery?
faqs.answer: Before dispatch, the bike undergoes a final pre-delivery inspection, full servicing, and a thorough cleaning. All relevant documents are also packed and handed over.

faqs.question: Is the bike insured during transit?
faqs.answer: Yes, all bikes are fully insured during transit. In the rare event of any damage during delivery, we take full responsibility for repairs or replacements.

faqs.question: What is the return policy if I am not satisfied?
faqs.answer: You can return the bike within 3 days of delivery if there is a significant issue not disclosed in the listing. Our team will review the case and initiate a resolution promptly.

faqData.question: What should I check before buying a used bike?
faqData.answer: Always check the service history, RC book, insurance, chassis number, and test the bike's overall condition.

faqData.question: How do I know if a used bike is accident-free?
faqData.answer: Inspect the chassis and frame for welding or damage, or get it inspected by our experts.

faqData.question: Can I get a loan to buy a used bike?
faqData.answer: Yes, we offer easy financing options with low-interest EMIs for eligible customers.

faqData.question: Is test ride available before purchasing?
faqData.answer: Yes, you can test ride the bike at our hub or request a home test ride (based on availability).

faqData.question: How is RC transfer handled?
faqData.answer: We take care of complete RC transfer and ensure it's done safely and legally.

faqData.question: What documents do I need to buy a used bike?
faqData.answer: You'll need an ID proof, address proof, and a passport-size photo.

faqData.question: How do I sell my bike through WheelsForDeals?
faqData.answer: Submit your bike details, and we'll contact you for inspection and price estimation.

faqData.question: How do you decide the price of my bike?
faqData.answer: Pricing is based on your bike's condition, model, year, kilometers run, and current market rates.

faqData.question: How long does it take to get payment after selling?
faqData.answer: Once the deal is confirmed and paperwork is completed, payment is done on the same day.

faqData.question: Who will handle the paperwork and RC transfer after I sell?
faqData.answer: We handle the full RC transfer and ownership change to ensure a smooth experience for you.
